comparison.objective: Set and arm a bedside alarm clock; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Discrete button pressing and device-state control versus continuous mechanical adjustment with two concentric tools.
comparison.success_condition: Display reads 07:15, alarm armed, buttons released versus 90° stop retained after three cycles.
comparison.reason: A shared notion of setting a value is abstract and does not establish physical-skill overlap.
